segments.text: Old friend to the king and self-appointed guardian of the princess. Though quick to draw the sword in his younger days, he has calmed down of late.
Lord of a house particularly esteemed among the others. A captive to beauty and music, he sometimes lets his passions run wild.
An old lord with a rather unpleasant personality. He has little interest in the affairs of the world and spends most of his time locked in his room.
A lord who can depend only on the prestige of his old family and his connections to the councilor. Completely spoiled and unable to take care of himself. Though, he is kind to those he accepts...
A cowardly but gentle young knight. His abilities are limited, but his family is wealthy and he is able to support himself.
A blind lord who rules over southern land. A vigorous learner, he boasts a deep knowledge. Combat is not his strong suit, however.
An earnest bodybuilder ever-looking to bulk himself up. Though loved by his people for his generous policies, some regard him with contempt...
A boy who succeeded his fallen parents as lord. He has a sensitive side to him, and few have seen him smile.
A werewolf knight. His kind boast combat potential surpassing human abilities, but he is still young and incomplete in body and mind.
A werewolf knight. His kind boast combat potential surpassing human abilities, but he is still young and incomplete in body and mind.
A knight with blood of a foreign noble. He has travelled far and wide, and boasts a large range of knowledge.
A genius knight blessed with high martial talent. He is sickly and often bedridden, but he is said to be the strongest young knight in the land when given a lance on a horse.
Previously known as a lady's man, now he avoids the spotlight due to a bad leg.
A warrior said to be a hero from a faraway kingdom to the south. Brought into our kingdom due to connections here, he lives as a knight.
Not much stands out about this quiet knight-errant. He is looking for a stable employer to support his beloved family.
A knight who is unmoved by the amount of infamy he has built up. If you hire him, be ready for the dishonor that he will bring.
An easygoing, cheerful young knight. He is always with his beloved cat. He has average abilities, but is not so skilled that you can rely on him.
A young knight who is a bit lacking in etiquette. Although he hails from a good family, he seems to keep unfortunate company often.
A ghostly lord who works without rest. His unique attributes have given him a different outlook on life from most people, making him difficult to keep up with.
A sturdy woman who rules over her territory in her deceased husband's stead. She has the ability to joust as any other knight.
An isolated knight who always trains alone, seeking to reach the height of martial prowess. Rumored to be the strongest of humankind, he can be trusted with anything that requires muscle.
A young knight who wishes to raise through the ranks. Though his abilities do not match his confidence and he lacks etiquette, there is something special about his ambition.
The hero who fought with Kurokizoku many years ago and rebuffed his invasion. Now elderly, he does not possess a fraction of his old strength.
The fifteen-year-old princess. The blood of the legendary King of Knights fills her veins, and her true abilities are yet unknown.
Though a member of the royal family, she relinquished her right to succeed the throne to become the princess's lady in waiting. Everything she does, she does for the princess's happiness.
A consul who is always beside the princess to support her. Devoting himself to the royal family like his father before him, he will not fold to any temptation.
Kurokizoku's substitute. Masterful in politics and battle as well as very loyal. Rumor has it that he is no human...
The young man thought to succeed the councilor. Though his skills are not yet up to par, he has the potential and a bright future.
A flighty young knight who is always hitting on women. His skilled tongue makes him a master at winning hearts and minds.
A boy knight who ascended to the head of one of the most prestigious families in the land at a young age. Though a child and lacking in health, he is skilled in combat and politics.
A boorish youth who was the prince's bodyguard. His overwhelming toughness has people saying he is like a bull.
A young man with a foreign air to him. Though noble and difficult to deal with, he has the abilities to make it worth it.
A veteran royal guard to the former king. Though well-loved by the people, his expenses are high. Hiring him will cost quite the sum of funds.
The most powerful figure in the kingdom. Even key players in foreign lands respect his political abilities. His methods are insidious and precise.
Leader of the Dunkelheit in the outskirts of the land. Fickle and cruel.
The kingdom's representative of the mysterious organization, the Forum. "All for the future of the children of men."
